title: Innovation, collaboration help engineering student build confidence in the classroom and on the track
summary_en: Sometimes a child’s toy can lead to inspiration for where to go to college. That’s what happened to Youssuf Elhawary, who’s originally from Cairo, Egypt.
title_cn: Innovation, collaboration help engineering student build confidence in the classroom and on the track

title: Purdue MEM students partner with EatCloud to expand food rescue through AI-powered WhatsApp solution
summary_en: A team of students in Purdue University’s Master of Engineering Management (MEM) program partnered with Colombia-based social enterprise EatCloud to develop technology solutions aimed at reducing food waste while expanding access to food for communities in need.
title_cn: Purdue MEM students partner with EatCloud to expand food rescue through AI-powered WhatsApp solution
